entities.summary: Nuestra Señora de la Soterraña Spanish pronunciation: [ˈnwestɾa seˈɲoɾa ðe la soteˈraɲa] is a Gothic church and monastery located at Santa María la Real de Nieva, Province of Segovia, Spain. It was built between late 14th and early 15th centuries.
